dedupe_keys.name: cape analytics property intelligence roof condition and peril attributes from imagery

description: CAPE Analytics sells property intelligence for insurers, lenders and real estate investors, derived from high-resolution geospatial imagery with computer vision and fused with structured data. Examples shown on its pages are roof condition and geometry, tree overhang, pool count, exterior condition, living area, distance to a park and wildfire risk; separate product pages cover roof age, hail, wind and wildfire intelligence, peril metrics and Primary Property Elements, the last of which gives above-grade living area, number of stories, quality grade, garage type and size, exterior finish, year built and bathroom count for replacement cost estimates. Coverage: individual residential and commercial properties; the pages read use United States insurance terms such as Coverage A, but the countries covered were not stated. Format and access: an API with responses under two seconds, batch processing of client portfolios, and web applications to view imagery and property characteristics; sold through consultations. Licence: proprietary; terms and prices were not read. Caveats: the site is marketing text, the claims about wildfire and wind losses on the home page were not checked, and the site's icons carry Moody's branding, but the ownership was not read in text. Simulation uses: building-level condition and vulnerability attributes for hazard exposure and damage models of housing stock. Related records: Ecopia AI vector maps (data-ecopia-ai-vector-maps-buildings-land-cover-transport) are another commercial building dataset from imagery, and Microsoft's building footprints (data-microsoft-global-ml-building-footprints) are an open one.
